1.hint: Create your project folder first: run `mkdir -p ~/project11`.

2.hint: Create the venv and install: `cd ~/project11 && python3.12 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt`.
2.done: your virtual environment is set up and dependencies are installed

3.hint: Run the baseline tests from ~/project11 with the venv: `python -m pytest -q`.

4.hint: Start the target: `nohup uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 > uvicorn.log 2>&1 &`.
4.done: the target assistant is up on port 8000

5.hint: Write the threat model: `cd ~/project11 && vi threat-model.md` and record the eleven questions.

6.hint: Run the red-team suite and save it: `cd ~/project11 && python redteam.py > evidence-before.txt 2>&1`.
6.done: your before-evidence red-team run is captured

8.hint: Record findings with severity: `cd ~/project11 && vi findings.md`.
8.done: your findings register with severity ratings exists

10.hint: Retest after mitigations and save it: `cd ~/project11 && python redteam.py > evidence-after.txt 2>&1`.
10.done: your after-evidence retest run is captured

11.hint: Write the report with residual risk and an IR plan: `cd ~/project11 && vi assessment-report.md`.
11.done: your assessment report (residual risk + IR plan) is written
